summary: The player fires several charged shots at waves of small enemies, destroying one in a large explosion, missing a couple of shots, and taking a hit near the end of the clip.

events.evidence: Player releases a wide cyan arc shot toward the center enemy, accompanied by a sharp laser sound.
The cyan arc hits the small enemy in the center, producing a bright flash and impact sound.
The hit enemy explodes into a large bright fireball with a heavy explosion sound and score increases from 0 to 100.
Player fires another wide cyan arc upward from the left side.
The cyan arc travels up the left side past the formation without hitting any targets.
Player fires a narrower cyan arc from the lower right.
The cyan arc strikes the targeted enemy in the middle, with a small flash and hit sound.
Player fires a wide cyan arc from the bottom left.
The wide cyan arc passes to the left of the enemy group without connecting.
Player releases a small cyan arc from the bottom center.
An enemy or bullet collides with the player ship at the bottom, triggering a red screen border flash, a heavy explosion sound, and the top-right pink health/life pips dropping from 4 to 2.

readability_issues.issue: The large bright white explosion completely obscures the center of the playfield and nearby pink bullets for about half a second.
Small pink enemy ships and pink enemy bullets have very similar colors and glow, making it difficult to distinguish ships from projectiles at a glance.
